## Type of change
- [ ] `feat` — New feature or component
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation, research notes, or meeting notes
- [ ] `style` — UI styling, formatting (no logic change)
- [ ] `refactor` — Code restructure (no behavior change)
- [ ] `test` — Adding or updating tests

## Checklist
- [ ] My code builds locally (`npm run build` passes in `client/`)
- [ ] I have tested my changes in the browser
- [ ] I have not committed any API keys, secrets, or `.env` files
- [ ] I have not committed large binary files (GeoTIFF, DEM, HDF5)
- [ ] My commit messages follow the format: `type: short description`
